results.Recipient Name: PAE AVIATION AND TECHNICAL SERVICES LLC
results.Transaction Description: THE AVIATION FIELD MAINTENANCE (AFM) SERVICE CONTRACTS PROVIDE AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE SERVICES TO THE NUMEROUS AVIATION MAJOR WEAPON SYSTEMS AND PLATFORMS, NAMELY: AH64, UH60 A/L/M, CH47F, AND OH58 (FOREIGN MILITARY SALES SUPPORT) ACROSS THE GLOBE.  ACTIONS FOR THESE SYSTEMS CONSIST OF MODIFICATIONS AGAINST COMPETITIVELY AWARDED CONTRACTS UTILIZING COST PLUS INCENTIVE FEE, FIRM FIXED PRICE, FIXED PRICED LEVEL OF EFFORT, COST PLUS FIXED FEE LEVEL OF EFFORT, AND COST REIMBURSEMENT LINES THAT WERE NEGOTIATED TO PROVIDE THE ARMY WITH FLEXIBILITY IN STRUCTURING, MANAGING, AND STREAMLINING ITS HIGHLY COMPLEX AVIATION MAINTENANCE WORKLOAD.   THESE CONTRACTS SUPPORT AIRCRAFT RESET, WHICH INCLUDES ALL REPAIR EFFORTS NECESSARY TO ATTAIN A FULLY UPDATED MISSION CAPABLE AIRCRAFT CONDITION, AS WELL AS, MODIFICATION WORK ORDERS TO INSTALL MODIFICATIONS TO THOSE AIRCRAFT.  THE AFM REQUIREMENT ALSO PROVIDES AVIATION MAINTENANCE FOR MULTIPLE LEVELS OF EFFORT TO THE DIRECTORATE OF LOGISTICS AND COMBAT AVIATION BRIGADES AT VARIOUS SITES GLOBALLY.
